provenance.design_rationale: Lubricant is a combustible petroleum fraction (similar to heavy fuel oil). GT6 reserves lubricant for cutter/CNC machine cooling (6,599 recipes), but CC's CUTTER is a T16-deferred machine on deprecated KINETIC and cannot serve as a v1 consumer. This DESIGN_POLICY recipe provides a real consumer on an accepted machine (fuels_engine, T18): burning lubricant as low-grade fuel at reduced efficiency (4 KU/t, 50mB). The carbon_dioxide output is minimal (5mB) and represents combustion exhaust. Not a void consumer — lubricant is converted to kinetic energy. Post-1.0 cutter/CNC machines will provide the primary GT6-parity consumer.
